summary: 8x8-foot ground-cab lookout on Deasey Mountain, Maine: built 1929, used until 1969, restored by the Park Service in 2024; now within Katahdin Woods and Waters.

facts.design: 8x8-foot ground cab, not on a tower, anchored by cables to granite eyebolts

access.note: Reached on foot by the International Appalachian Trail; camping not permitted at the lookout. Pages read do not describe the cab interior.

visit.trail_note: Shortest hike 5 miles from Wassataquoik Gate; ford of Wassataquoik Stream required; 10-mile round trip

National Park Service Maintenance Action Team restored the lookout to its historic appearance

corrections.proposed: National Park Service (Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument)
corrections.why: Park Service pages place the lookout inside the monument and describe a 2024 NPS restoration. The Register entry names Elliotsville Plantation. The land transfer is not documented in the pages read, so this is a proposed update, not confirmed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 1,876 ft; the Park Service peak page gives 1,942 ft; the Park Service lookout page gives 1,950 ft. The brief's 571.8 m matches the Register figure. All three are reported in the story.

The Register (registered 2006) names Elliotsville Plantation; Park Service pages describe the lookout as part of the national monument. Both are reported; the sources do not show which is current on the land.

notes_for_editor: Brief agency (Elliotsville Plantation) may be out of date; the proposed NPS correction is flagged but not confirmed by a land-record source. Brief kind=ground and elevation 571.8 m agree with the Register. Park Service elevations (1,942 and 1,950 ft) differ from the Register. Park Service pages carry photos but no license line was read, so no photo is added. The Weebly page (easternuslookouts) was read for context only and is not cited.
